page.overview:
Who is Devil Kazumi?

Devil Kazumi is the devil manifestation of Kazumi Mishima. The Devil Gene is passed on in the Hachijo Clan, where it is used for stealth assassination of targets who threaten the order and stability of the world. Kazumi trained and grew up alongside Heihachi Mishima, and the two were eventually married and had a son. When Heihachi's path veered towards evil, Kazumi tried to dissuade him to no avail. She then grew repeatedly sick, and in each episode, a violent alter ego appeared to take over her. Eventually this resulted in the full manifestation of Devil Kazumi, the demonic form used by the Hachijos to carry out their missions. Devil Kazumi told Heihachi her purpose had always been to kill him should he choose an evil path, and proceeded to attack him. She was defeated by Heihachi and killed. She passed the Devil Gene on however to her son, Kazuya Mishima.

Devil Kazumi's overall design is inspired by that of a kijo and borrows many elements from kabuki theatre design. Her colour scheme is roughly an inversion of her human appearance as Kazumi Mishima. She has red eyes, long white hair with hime cut bangs, and grayish-white skin. She has red markings similar to those used in kabuki theatre makeup on her forehead, neck, wrists, legs, and feet. Spiked, brilliant blue gems grow out of her wrists, neck, knees, and ankles. When her Rage is activated, the color of the gems becomes bright red.

She wears a long white kimono with a red interior. The edge of its sleeves and hem are cut into flame designs. Like her human counterpart, Devil Kazumi wears her kimono with the material crossed right side over left, in the fashion reserved for the dead. She wears a white obi over her kimono which is tied with red rope about her waist. It has a gray butterfly shaped design at the back and a gold Mishima Zaibatsu logo at the front. She has red horns which curve slightly before pointing vertical, and flaming red and gold wings.

Devil Kazumi makes her first and only appearance in the Story Mode in Tekken 7. Kazumi falls ill and becomes violent a number of times, with Heihachi caring for her in each of these episodes. Eventually, Kazumi's devil form manifests in full and she confronts her husband in the Mishima Dojo. Kazumi Mishima reveals to her husband the reason why she married him. She tells him it is because her family, the Hachijo Clan, want to kill him to avert terrible chaos and death, and that she was to be the one to stop him if he started walking down this path. After a long and grueling fight, Kazumi attempts to kill Heihachi with a Devil's Beam but misses, prompting her to punch him in the face. Heihachi retaliates by uppercutting her, seemingly killing her. Kazumi lies unconscious on the floor, having reverted back to her human form. After Heihachi checks on her body and turns to leave, Kazumi transforms back into her devil form again to attack him from behind. Heihachi grabs her by the neck before she can do so.
